title: NeoBoard external plugin manifest
description: Declares external chart plugins to import at build time. Each entry must resolve to an npm package that is installed (declared in app/package.json or a workspace) and exports a ChartPlugin.

package.description: The npm package name to import (e.g. '@myorg/neoboard-heatmap' or './plugins/my-local').

export.description: Named export to import. Defaults to 'default' (the package's default export).

overrides.description: When true, this plugin is allowed to replace a built-in plugin with the same chart type. Defaults to false — duplicates are rejected at registration.
